controls.description: Evidence is generated from one clean reconstructable Git commit and immutable project tree.
AgentCore Batch Evaluation authorizes production promotion and rejects degraded/forged/stale evidence.
Promotion evidence uses the exact target-account and target-Region customer-managed key.
Caller-bound workforce identity reaches Gateway token exchange without direct Runtime bearer bypass.
Mandatory model and tool input/output Guardrails fail closed without sensitive trace disclosure.
Production tool calls are default-deny Cedar ENFORCE and agent roles cannot mutate governance.
Production mutation intent is append-only, digest-verified, fail-closed, and exposes incomplete outcomes.
Applicable limits reserve atomically before mediated operations; exhaustion/storage failures block dispatch.
Signed webhook IDs bind body digests, enqueue once, recover crashes, and retain worker-side deduplication.
JIT approval leases IAM application and cannot race rejection or grant Gateway/Policy mutation.
Versioned CloudFront SDK/Web Component invokes only production with request-local tokens and inert rendering.
A selected connector is credentialed by reference, tool-discovered, called under Cedar/Guardrails, and torn down.
Production can roll back only to the exact prior production version and serves it after rollback.
Teardown confirms absence across direct service inventories, including alias-less keys and log groups.
Core Runtime/Gateway/Identity/Policy/Evaluation behavior is independently verified in every documented EMEA core Region.
